title: Engine Overtime Fee Line on Ridgeline Tool Rental Agreements
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental bills engine overtime on returned metered equipment as a fee line of its own on the rental agreement. This page is the agent reference for booking that line.

## Capability

`bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269` books a single engine overtime fee line, dated today, on one returned Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement for metered equipment, and raises the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the amount billed. The renter sees the overtime charge as its own fee line and a higher balance. The tool records the amount it is given; it does not work the amount out.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the Customer Care agent unlocks `bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_agreement_id` | The reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the overtime is billed on, as returned by the rental agreement lookup. | Id |
| `overtime_amount` | The engine overtime charge, in USD. | A positive number with 2 decimal places and no currency sign; stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places. |

## Return

On success the receipt returns `status` "billed" when the overtime fee line was booked; `rental_charge_id`, the reference of the new fee line; `rental_agreement_id`, the agreement it was booked on; `fee_type`, always `overtime_hours`; `amount`, the charge billed in USD with 2 decimal places; and `balance_due`, the amount now owed on the agreement in USD with 2 decimal places.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Called with an agreement's reference and `overtime_amount` 312.40 on an agreement owing 0.00, the tool returns `status` "billed", a new `rental_charge_id`, `fee_type` `overtime_hours`, `amount` 312.40 and `balance_due` 312.40.
